exec: Check Point says Q3 2026 was the highest-volume quarter on record, with 2,830 victims published on data leak sites.
plain: Security firm Check Point says the third quarter of 2026 had the most ransomware victims named on leak sites of any quarter it has recorded: 2,830.

key_findings: Check Point says Q3 2026 was the highest-volume quarter on record, with 2,830 victims published on data leak sites.
117 distinct brands claimed at least one victim in Q3.

summary: Check Point Research's Q3 2026 ransomware report says the quarter was the highest-volume on record, with 2,830 victims published on data leak sites. It says 117 distinct brands claimed at least one victim. These are Check Point's own counts.
title: Check Point says Q3 2026 ransomware leak-site victims hit a record 2,830

validation.note: Read Check Point Research's own report page; figures are the vendor's own counts. CAJ News Africa relayed it but was not used as a source.
